issues.title_en: New transmission from animals likely caused Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak, study says
issues.summary: DAKAR, Aug 11 - The ongoing Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo concerns a previously unseen variant of the rare Bundibugyo species of the virus, indicating it stemmed from a new transmission from animals to humans rather than from variants linked to earlier outbreaks, a new study said. Read more at straitstimes.com.

issues.title_en: Drought and the war in Ukraine changed what families in Kenya could afford to eat
issues.summary: Russia's invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 had an almost immediate impact on global energy markets and the movement of food around the world. During the first year of the conflict, international crude oil and natural gas prices rose sharply. Disruptions to exports of wheat, maize, sunflower oil and fertilizers from Russia and Ukraine contributed to record global food prices.
